classes.description: Switching Rule — 定义 AQL 抽样检验的切换规则（例如从正常检验自动切换到加严或放宽检验）。包含切换规则明细、邮件分发、邮件模板等配置。支持版本化管理（name+revision）。

properties.name: switchingRuleBase
properties.description: 切换规则基线版本 → SwitchingRuleBase (SwitchingRuleBaseId)

properties.name: setupAccess
properties.description: 关联的建模访问权限（A_SetupAccess）。

properties.name: eco
properties.description: 工程变更单号

properties.name: revision
properties.description: 版本号（必填）

properties.name: description
properties.description: 描述说明

properties.name: notes
properties.description: 备注说明

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结（只读）

properties.name: changeHistory
properties.description: 变更历史记录 → ChangeStatus (ChangeHistoryId)

properties.name: status
properties.description: 状态：1=Active, 2=Inactive

properties.name: eMailMessage
properties.description: 关联的默认邮件消息模板 → EMailMessage (EMailMessageId)

properties.name: wipMsgDefMgr
properties.description: 关联的WIP消息定义管理器 → WIPMsgDefMgr (WIPMsgDefMgrId)

properties.name: eMailDistribution
properties.description: 关联的默认邮件分发组 → EMailDistribution (EMailDistributionId)

properties.name: iconId
properties.description: 关联图标的标识符。

properties.name: filterTags
properties.description: 分类筛选标签

classes.description: Switching Rule Details — 具体的切换规则明细。定义在何种抽样测试类型下（如连续X批合格/不合格），从原检验等级（fromInspectionLevel）切换到目标检验等级（toInspectionLevel）。支持自动切换或邮件通知。

properties.name: switchingRuleType
properties.description: 切换规则测试类型：1=Passed (合格数), 2=Failed (不合格数)

properties.name: allowAutomaticSwitching
properties.description: 是否允许规则自动切换

properties.name: eMailDistribution
properties.description: 触发通知时关联的邮件分发组 → EMailDistribution (EMailDistributionId)

properties.name: lastContainerSetCount
properties.description: 回溯检查 of 批/容器总数限制 (Y值)

properties.name: expression
properties.description: 统一的条件判定表达式，返回布尔值

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结（只读）

properties.name: toInspectionLevel
properties.description: 目标检验等级/AQL等级 → InspectionLevel (ToInspectionLevelId)

properties.name: passOrFailContainerCount
properties.description: 合格或不合格的批/容器数量限制 (X值)

properties.name: switchingRule
properties.description: 所属的切换规则（必填） → SwitchingRule (SwitchingRuleId)

properties.name: fromInspectionLevel
properties.description: 起始检验等级/AQL等级 → InspectionLevel (FromInspectionLevelId)

properties.name: requireNotification
properties.description: 可切换时是否触发邮件通知
